# WeatherNow

> WeatherNow is a modern, real-time global weather web application providing accurate meteorological data, live atmospheric conditions, and 5-day weather forecasts for cities worldwide.

- **Website**: https://weather-web-app-eight-beryl.vercel.app/
- **Data Provider**: OpenWeatherMap API
- **Application Type**: Real-Time Weather Forecast & Meteorological Dashboard
- **License / Usage**: Free public web access

## Core Features
- **Real-Time Weather**: Current temperature, "feels like" index, daily high/low temperatures, weather conditions, atmospheric pressure, relative humidity, and wind speed.
- **5-Day Meteorological Forecast**: Projections with daily precipitation probability, minimum/maximum temperature ranges, and weather summaries.
- **Global Search & Geolocation**: Instant search for any city globally or automatic detection via browser geolocation coordinates.
- **Temperature Units**: Seamless one-click conversion between Celsius (°C) and Fahrenheit (°F).
- **Favorites & Search History**: Client-side storage for frequently checked locations and recent searches.
- **Adaptive Visual Themes**: Dynamic background gradients that reflect current atmospheric conditions (clear, rain, snow, clouds, thunderstorm) with full light and dark mode support.

## Key Pages & Endpoints
- Homepage & Live Forecast: https://weather-web-app-eight-beryl.vercel.app/
- Sitemap: https://weather-web-app-eight-beryl.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
- Robots Configuration: https://weather-web-app-eight-beryl.vercel.app/robots.txt
